classifications.rationale: The President presently establishes the exclusive classification levels and the substantive standards governing which level applies; classifiers implement those already-binding legal statuses later.
classifications.evidence: National security information (hereinafter "classified information") shall be classified at one of the following three levels

classifications.rationale: The provision itself immediately requires doubtful information to receive classified safeguards until the classification authority decides its status within 30 days.
classifications.evidence: it shall be safeguarded as if it were classified pending a determination

classifications.rationale: This inseparably combines an immediate higher-level safeguarding requirement with internal allocations and delegation limits for classification authority.
classifications.evidence: it shall be safeguarded at the higher level of classification pending a determination by an original classification authority

classifications.rationale: The segment combines internal delegation documentation and referral procedures with an immediate duty to protect information as classified while an agency later makes a discretionary classification determination.
classifications.evidence: the information shall be protected in a manner consistent with this Order and its implementing directives

classifications.rationale: The provision presently defines classification criteria, presumptions, duration, continuing classification status, and document-marking duties; later officials apply those binding rules to particular information.
classifications.evidence: Information that is determined to concern one or more of the categories in Section 1.3(a) shall be classified

classifications.rationale: The provision presently preserves or assigns classification status, prohibits classifications for specified purposes, and establishes binding conditions on reclassification and derivative classification.
classifications.evidence: Information assigned a level of classification under predecessor orders shall be considered as classified at that level of classification

classifications.rationale: The segment combines internal preparation and approval of classification guides with a mandate that officials later produce the legally consequential result of declassification or downgrading when national-security considerations permit.
classifications.evidence: Information shall be declassified or downgraded as soon as national security considerations permit.

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines review and coordination assignments with present originating-agency status rules and mandates governing later declassification decisions.
classifications.evidence: the receiving agency shall be deemed to be the originating agency for purposes of this Order

classifications.rationale: The provision presently makes qualifying information subject to mandatory review, exempts presidential materials, and grants the Archivist authority over specified records.
classifications.evidence: all information classified under this Order or predecessor orders shall be subject to a review for declassification by the originating agency

classifications.rationale: The segment combines internal review and appeal procedures with a present continuation of classified status and mandates agencies to produce later declassification and release outcomes after review.
classifications.evidence: Agencies conducting a mandatory review for declassification shall declassify information no longer requiring protection under this Order.

classifications.rationale: Agency heads must later develop internal procedures for processing and administratively appealing mandatory-review requests, without a dictated outcome on any information.
classifications.evidence: Agency heads shall develop procedures to process requests for the mandatory review of classified information.

classifications.rationale: The Secretary of Defense is assigned the internal task of developing review procedures, with no specified classification or disclosure outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of Defense shall develop special procedures for the review of cryptologic information

classifications.rationale: The Director of Central Intelligence must develop internal review procedures after agency consultation, but the provision does not dictate results in particular reviews.
classifications.evidence: the Director of Central Intelligence shall develop special procedures for the review of information

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines internal review and referral procedures, mandated later responses to requesters, and present substantive rules governing eligibility for access and dissemination of classified information.
classifications.evidence: A person is eligible for access to classified information provided that a determination of trustworthiness has been made

classifications.rationale: Agency heads must maintain an internal accounting system, while the remaining provisions authorize—but do not require—agencies to grant access waivers under prescribed safeguards.
classifications.evidence: Each agency head shall establish and maintain a system of accounting for special access programs.

classifications.rationale: The provision organizes and assigns executive-branch policy, implementation, staffing, oversight, review, reporting, and coordination responsibilities; any later directives remain part of internal administration.
classifications.evidence: The National Security Council shall provide overall policy direction for the information security program.

classifications.rationale: The Director must make an internal report when a possible violation is found so that the agency may consider discretionary corrective steps later.
classifications.evidence: the Director shall make a report to the head of the agency

classifications.rationale: The provision itself makes covered government personnel and affiliated persons subject to sanctions upon specified violations, while agency heads later select and implement appropriate corrective action.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to appropriate sanctions if they

classifications.rationale: The operative actor must provide an internal violation notification promptly; the rest supplies definitions for administering the order rather than independently changing a person's legal status.
classifications.evidence: Either shall ensure that the Director of the Information Security Oversight Office is promptly notified
